hook: Year-end recap: four ideas to take into the new year.

scenes.narration: Your chance of finding a block is your share of network hashrate.
Electricity and efficiency decide whether mining pays.
Nodes validate every block, whoever mined it.
Returns vary, and none are ever promised.

cta: Which idea stuck? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Year-End Recap: 4 Bitcoin Mining Ideas
description_body: Lottery, costs, rules and no promises: four ideas to carry into the new year.
